wording.service: Contact me about this enquiry and my job.
wording.reviews: After the job, send me a link to leave a review.
wording.marketing: Send me occasional reminders and offers. I can reply STOP at any time.

leadIntake.sms: Hi {firstName}, thanks for contacting {businessName} about {service}. A plumber will call you today. Reply STOP to opt out.
leadIntake.email:
Hi {firstName},

Thanks for getting in touch with {businessName} about {service}. We've received your enquiry and one of our team will contact you within one business day.

If it's urgent, call us on {businessPhone}.

{signoff}

reviews.sms: Hi {firstName}, thanks for choosing {businessName} for your {service}. If you're happy with the work, a quick Google review would really help us: {reviewUrl} Reply STOP to opt out.

reactivation.sms: Hi {firstName}, it's {businessName}. You asked us about {service} a while ago - is it still on your list? Reply YES and we'll call you to book a free inspection. Reply STOP to opt out.
reactivation.email:
Hi {firstName},

A while ago you asked {businessName} about {service}. If it's still on your list, just reply to this email and we'll book a free inspection at a time that suits you.

{signoff}

Don't want these emails? Reply STOP.
